items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Who played with Sam Morgan then? ... Johnny Deve, Alfred Williams.

ctx.x: Do you remember who played with Manuel Perez in those years? I don't know why I just know them. Who played with Sam Morgan then?
Well, Big Jim, Little Jim, Johnny Deve, Alfred Williams. Well they didn't have, Oilo Fusje, Andrew Morgan. How about eight men?
Did he have a second car now?
